reference: PLAN: 1. Find the information about the telenova "El Ardiente Secreto" and its basis on a novel. 2. Identify which novel it is based on and determine under what pen name that novel was published.

descendants_plus.hop_1: FINDING: The telenovela "El Ardiente Secreto" is based on the novel "Jane Eyre", published under the pen name "Currer Bell".

corruptions.text: PLAN: First, identify the American country singer who had a career spanning almost 60 years. Then, determine which album by this singer was released in 1972 and is considered his last studio album with Decca Records.

descendants.hop_1: FINDING: The American country singer who had a career spanning almost 60 years is Johnny Cash, and his album released in 1972 that was considered his last studio album with Decca Records is "The Last Performances".
